Container.Name: FennCart
Container.Overview: Convert grocery shopping lists into loaded Kroger/Fry's carts. Paste a natural language shopping list, FennCart matches items against your learned brand preferences using an LLM, presents selections for review, and adds confirmed items to your Kroger cart. Requires your own Kroger developer credentials and LLM API key.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the FennCart web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database and encryption key.

Config.Name: KROGER_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Kroger developer API client ID from developer.kroger.com

Config.Name: KROGER_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Kroger developer API client secret from developer.kroger.com

Config.Name: LLM_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your Anthropic, OpenAI, or other LLM API key. Leave blank for local Ollama.

Config.Name: LLM_PROVIDER
Config.Description: LLM provider: anthropic, openai, or ollama

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Random string for session cookie signing. Generate with: python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))'

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: URL users access in their browser. Used for Kroger OAuth redirect. Set to your Unraid IP:port or reverse proxy URL.
